rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a barren or devastated landscape.

example.english: After the war, the whole city centre became a moonscape.
example.traditional: 戰爭過後，成個市中心變成一片荒涼景象。
example.jyutping: zin3 zang1 gwo3 hau6 sing4 go3 si5 zung1 sam1 bin3 sing4 jat1 pin3 fong1 loeng4 ging2 zoeng6

rows.jyutping: jyut6 kau4 biu1 min2 ge3 ging2 zoeng6
rows.note: Use this specifically for the visual appearance of an area on the Moon.

example.english: The photo shows a stunning moonscape.
example.traditional: 張相影到月球表面嘅景象，好震撼。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng3 jing2 dou3 jyut6 kau4 biu1 min2 ge3 ging2 zoeng6 hou2 zan3 ham6
